Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

Let's go! · Do you want to…?
FormUseExample
Let's + verbsuggestion (us)Let's go!
Do you want to…?invite (friendly)Do you want to come?
Would you like to…?invite (polite)Would you like to join us?
object pronounsme/you/us/themCall me. Come with us.
  • Let's + verb (base) = a suggestion for us: Let's go! Let's watch a film.
  • Invite: Do you want to…? (friendly) / Would you like to…? (polite) + verb: Do you want to meet tomorrow?
  • Object pronouns: me / you / him / her / it / us / them. Call me. Come with us.
  • Say yes: Yes, sounds good! Say no nicely: Sorry, I can't. Maybe next time.

→ Talking about the past (was / were) comes next.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: Let's + verb → Let's go! Pronouns after the verb: call ME, come with US.
  • ⚠ Позвони мне / маған қоңырау шал = call ME — not 'call to me'.

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two invitations: Let's … ! / Do you want to … ? .

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

Let's go to the theatre this evening! Do you want to come? We can meet at six. Would you like to invite your friends?

Check yourself:

  • Did you use Let's + verb or Do you want to…?
  • Is the verb in the base form after Let's (Let's go)?
  • Did you answer nicely (Sounds good / Sorry, I can't)?
Talk to Sam. Answer with the words from this lesson.

Read each message. Tap 🔊 to hear Sam.

Sam

Hi again! I'm Sam. 👋

Sam

Do you want to go to the cinema? 🎬

Sam

Great! 🎬

Sam

Let's meet at seven. 🕖

Sam

Perfect! 😊

Sam

Listen: “Let's to go home.” 🤔

Why

Let's + base verb (no 'to'): Let's go! Let's meet. But Do you want TO go?

Sam

Yes! “Let's go home.” Great catch. 🌟

Feedback

Well done: you invited and answered nicely. Next time, say it out loud too.
